name: Rat Skull Talisman
body:
RAT SKULL TALISMAN

Aura faint necromancy; CL 3rd; Slot neck; Price 1,200 gp; Weight 1/2 lb.

DESCRIPTION

Constructed from the bleached skull of a giant rat strung on a chain of finger bones, this talisman allows the wearer to cast scare (DC 13 Will save) once per day.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells scare; Cost 600 gp.
